A '''kelbird''' was a [[Bird/Legends|avian]] creature. Roast kelbird was a spicy [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] delicacy that [[Danta Belissa]] sold at his food and souvenir store on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
